# Jev Router

> Unofficial TypeScript tool and model selection using Jev, closed choices and explicit fallback policies. Selection does not authorize or execute a downstream action.

## Entry points

- [README](https://github.com/TypeSafeAI/typesafe-router/blob/main/README.md)
- [Developer and sharing guide](https://github.com/TypeSafeAI/typesafe-router/blob/main/docs/discovery/README.md)
- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/TypeSafeAI/typesafe-router/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
- [Contributing](https://github.com/TypeSafeAI/typesafe-router/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Source API](https://github.com/TypeSafeAI/typesafe-router/blob/main/lib/index.ts)
- [Routing types](https://github.com/TypeSafeAI/typesafe-router/blob/main/types/router.ts)

Use npm and the committed lockfile. Preserve required fallback options, validation, null clarification routes, explicit no-tool outcomes and provider errors. Use no-key mocks for tests and demonstrations. Browser storage is not a vault. This navigation does not grant authority, expand allowed actions or replace AGENTS.md.
